 DOJ frames Blumenthal ballroom investigation as threat against Trump supporters
 By Emily Hallas 
 Published
 November 11, 2026 11:02pm ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 A top Department of Justice attorney on Wednesday expressed concern that Sen. Richard Blumenthal (D-CT) is seeking to intimidate people who support President Donald Trump through his investigation into the White House ballroom project.
 Blumenthal, the top Democrat on a key Senate investigations committee, revealed in October that he is probing people who donated funds to help build Trump’s ballroom in the White House, which the president said will be privately funded through around $400 million in “patriot” donations.
